description: Department of Local Governtment - Sabaragamuwa Province - Notify the By-Laws made by the Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the approval and publication of by-laws made by a local government body (Pradeshiya Sabha Pelmadulla) and approved by a provincial minister. The core content is about regulatory matters - specifically, by-laws for controlling vehicle parking and regulating public libraries. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks established under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. While it mentions government officials and ministries, the primary focus is on the legal/regulatory content rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
